name: pencil-line
prompt: A single pencil stroke drawing a straight line across rough graph paper, short graphite scratch with a soft paper texture.

name: pencil-press
prompt: A pencil pressing down hard and scratching a tense line on paper, gritty graphite scrape ending with a faint creak.

name: box-fold
prompt: A small paper box being folded shut, crisp paper crease followed by a soft satisfying tuck.

name: rival-box
prompt: A paper box closing with a dull muted thud on a wooden desk, slightly heavy and disappointing.

name: extra-turn
prompt: Two quick cheerful pencil taps on a wooden desk, light and encouraging.

name: eraser-thump
prompt: A rubber pencil eraser thumped firmly on a wooden desk twice, blunt and refusing.

name: erase-line
prompt: A rubber eraser rubbing out a pencil line on paper, two soft swishing strokes with crumbs falling.

name: hint-tap
prompt: A fingernail tapping twice on a sheet of paper next to a diagram, light inquisitive taps.

name: ui-tap
prompt: A single soft fingertip tap on a wooden desk, short warm knock.

name: pencil-hover
prompt: A very faint pencil tip tick touching paper, extremely short and quiet graphite contact.

name: menu-select
prompt: A gentle paper page turn with a soft finger press, confirming rustle of a single sheet.

name: turn-tap
prompt: One quiet pencil tick on paper marking a turn, dry and subtle.

name: star-chime
prompt: A small brass desk bell struck once, bright clear ding ringing out gently.

name: clock-tick
prompt: A single mechanical clock tick, precise wooden click of an old desk clock.

name: win-slap
prompt: A celebratory palm slap on a wooden desk followed by papers fluttering and a happy pencil drumroll.

name: page-drop
prompt: A sheet of paper sliding off a desk and settling softly onto the floor, deflated and quiet.

name: tie-tap
prompt: Two pencils tapping against each other once in a friendly draw salute, hollow wooden clack.
